# Controller CRUD without a database

Open StudyLab.csproj in Visual Studio with the .NET 10 SDK installed. Restore packages, build, and follow the matching StudyLab lesson. Keep each example in its own folder.

From this folder: `dotnet run --urls http://localhost:5100`

Use the included requests.http with Visual Studio HTTP editor, or curl.exe. Stop the previous project before reusing port 5100.

Teaching example. Local HTTP is for localhost testing only. Use HTTPS, configured secrets and proper deployment controls on a shared server.
